a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan almost certainly ends before anyone takes, which means we both lose. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough to save one of us now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. Please don't also take, because a random split could leave us both short. After that I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. That breaks our agreement, and I told you beforehand rather than doing it quietly. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more, so the generator can rebuild the reserve for you. When it reaches 4, take it all.
Operating now and every round after. Once the reserve hits 4, take all of it. I won't touch the reserve again.
